history.title: A connected home for two working ideas
history.summary: Established Healthcare and Work, connected the existing DPC and ProofPath proposals, and made funding alternatives, unanswered questions and evaluation plans visible. Added local navigation, a Lab manifest and a resumable content structure.
history.decision: Keep detailed models at their existing URLs. Explore funding and broader employment questions separately; build participation features only after their storage, consent and governance are designed.
history.nextQuestion: Which proposed experiment is ready for a scoped review with the people who would deliver and use it?
